rationales.description: Accruals exceptions totaling $711,808.57 exceed the $50,000 materiality threshold, posing a significant risk to financial accuracy and compliance.
rationales.recommended_action: Review and resolve accruals exceptions by validating supporting documentation and adjusting entries as necessary.

rationales.description: AP exceptions totaling $653,977.70 indicate potential control failures in accounts payable processes, which could lead to misstatements.
rationales.recommended_action: Investigate AP exceptions to identify root causes, implement corrective controls, and ensure compliance with internal policies.

rationales.description: AR exceptions totaling $2,586,167.48 highlight significant data quality issues that could compromise the accuracy of financial reporting.
rationales.recommended_action: Perform detailed reconciliation of AR balances, validate transaction data, and correct discrepancies to restore data integrity.

rationales.description: Bank duplicates totaling 13 instances suggest control failures in cash management processes, increasing the risk of duplicate transactions and financial misstatements.
rationales.recommended_action: Review duplicate bank transactions, implement stricter validation controls, and ensure proper segregation of duties.

rationales.description: Flux exceptions totaling 47 instances indicate potential non-compliance with regulatory requirements for variance analysis and financial reporting.
rationales.recommended_action: Conduct variance analysis to identify root causes of flux exceptions, document findings, and ensure compliance with audit standards.
